question: Which organisation launched the global initiative TRaNJA (Trade Not Just Aid) to support WTO reform and strengthen rule-based multilateral trade?
solution:
The correct answer is __**CUTS International.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **CUTS International launched TRaNJA (Trade Not Just Aid), a global initiative aimed at revitalizing the WTO and promoting equitable, rule-based multilateral trade.**
